label: 5 November 2026
title: Raphinha signs until 2030 after Villa brace; Rodri out for Atlético
deck: The captain formalises his extension with Laporta at noon. Barça took nine points from Aston Villa with goals from Yamal and Raphinha. Rodri has a minor right hamstring injury and will miss Sunday.

stories.headline: Raphinha signs new deal with Barcelona until 2030
stories.summary: Raphinha will formalise his contract extension until 30 June 2030 today at 12:00 in Joan Laporta’s office at Spotify Camp Nou. He will then speak to the media at 12:15 in the commercial room. The agreement was first announced by Deco at the September assembly.
stories.body: The club confirmed the schedule on Wednesday. The Brazilian, 29, had a deal that ran until 2028. Deco told the general assembly on 19 September that terms had been agreed the previous afternoon. Administrative details delayed the formal signature until after the Aston Villa match. Raphinha has scored 19 goals in 13 matches this season, 15 of them in La Liga. He is the fourth Brazilian with the most appearances and goals in Barcelona history. After the Villa brace he equalled Ronaldinho on 94 goals for the club. The ceremony takes place on the day after he was named player of the match.

stories.headline: Raphinha brace and Yamal opener give Barça 3-0 win over Villa
stories.summary: Barcelona beat Aston Villa 3-0 at Spotify Camp Nou on Tuesday. Lamine Yamal scored in the seventh minute. Raphinha added a deflected goal on 52 minutes and finished a Cancelo cross on 64. The side moved to nine points from four Champions League matches.
stories.body: Yamal pounced on a misplaced pass from João Gomes inside the box. Fermín López played Raphinha through for the second, which took a deflection off Pau Torres. Cancelo beat John McGinn and crossed for the third. Joan García made several saves as Villa created chances in an open first half. Brian Fariñas started at right-back and Gerard Martín in central defence. Attendance was 52,662. Davide Massa refereed. Barça sit second in the league phase on nine points, level with Villa, behind PSG on 12. The result ended Villa’s perfect start. Hansi Flick described the defensive display as important after the earlier defeat in Paris.

stories.headline: Rodri has minor right hamstring injury and misses Atlético
stories.summary: Rodri underwent medical tests after feeling discomfort against Aston Villa. The club confirmed a minor injury to the biceps femoris of his right leg. He will miss Sunday’s La Liga match at Atlético Madrid. Recovery time depends on how the injury develops.
stories.body: Hansi Flick substituted Rodri at half-time and brought on Marc Bernal. The club statement said the exact timeline will be set by the evolution of the problem. Rodri is also expected to miss Spain’s Nations League matches during the November break. Mundo Deportivo reported Flick has four options to replace him: Bernal, who has started the four matches Rodri has missed this season; Frenkie de Jong; Gavi; and Brian Fariñas as an emergency alternative. Atlético host on Sunday 8 November at 21:00. Barça lead the table by two points after 11 matches. Several senior defenders remain unavailable, including Eric García, Jules Koundé, Xavi Espart and Andreas Christensen.

stories.headline: Frenkie de Jong reaches 300 appearances for Barcelona
stories.summary: Frenkie de Jong made his 300th appearance for Barcelona as a substitute against Aston Villa. He replaced Pedri in the 70th minute. He is the Dutch player with the most games in club history, ahead of Philip Cocu (292) and Ronald Koeman (264).
stories.body: The club presented him with a special jersey marked ‘F. de Jong 300’ after the match. De Jong joined from Ajax in 2019. He has 20 goals and around 30 assists across those appearances. This was only his third outing of the 2026-27 season after a knee injury sustained at the World Cup. He played 15 minutes in the Clásico, started and played 82 minutes against Alavés, and came on late against Villa. He told the club he feels strong and motivated, with no pain in the knee. The milestone was marked on a night when Barça took nine points in the Champions League.

stories.headline: Yamal reaches 14 Champions League goals before turning 20
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal’s seventh-minute goal against Aston Villa took him to 14 Champions League goals. He is now the competition’s highest scorer before the age of 20, one ahead of Kylian Mbappé. He has scored the 14 goals in 37 appearances.
stories.body: Yamal had drawn level with Mbappé on 13 goals before this match. The goal came from a defensive error by Villa as Gomes passed the ball straight to him inside the box. He has scored in three of Barça’s four Champions League matches this season. Official figures list him with 14 goals and 13 assists in the competition. The record covers goals scored before a player’s 20th birthday. Yamal is 19. He also holds several other age-related marks in the competition, including youngest starter and youngest to score and assist in the same match. The Villa goal was his first in the Champions League since the defeat to PSG on 20 October.

stories.headline: Raphinha equals Ronaldinho on 94 Barcelona goals
stories.summary: Raphinha’s two goals against Aston Villa took his Barcelona total to 94, level with Ronaldinho. He has scored those 94 goals in fewer matches than the Brazilian. He now has 23 Champions League goals for the club.
stories.body: The club noted that Raphinha is the fourth Brazilian with the most appearances (190) and goals (94) in Barcelona history. The brace against Villa took his seasonal tally to 19 goals in 13 matches. Fifteen of those have come in La Liga. His Champions League total of 23 places him third on the club’s all-time list in the competition, behind Lionel Messi and Luis Suárez. He was named player of the match. The figures arrive on the day he is due to sign a contract that keeps him at the club until June 2030. He has been used primarily as the central striker under Hansi Flick this season.

stories.headline: Starters complete recovery session after Villa win
stories.summary: The players who started against Aston Villa had a post-match recovery session with gym work on Wednesday. The session was the first step of preparation for Sunday’s trip to Atlético Madrid at the Metropolitano.
stories.body: The club confirmed the recovery work for those who featured from the first whistle. Rodri was not among them after the medical confirmation of his hamstring injury. Several long-term absentees, including Eric García, Jules Koundé and Dani Olmo, continue separate programmes. The next competitive match is the La Liga fixture away to Atlético on 8 November at 21:00. After that, players will depart for national-team duty during the international break from 9 to 17 November. Barça then host Villarreal on 22 November. The recovery session followed a night in which Barça scored three times and kept a clean sheet in the Champions League.

stories.headline: Atlético Madrid next at the Metropolitano on Sunday
stories.summary: Barcelona travel to the Metropolitano on Sunday 8 November at 21:00 to face Atlético Madrid. The side lead La Liga by two points. Rodri is ruled out. Several senior defenders remain unavailable.
stories.body: The fixture is the second of five matches in November. After the international break, Barça host Villarreal on 22 November at 14:00, travel to Sabah in the Champions League on 25 November at 18:45, and finish the month away to Deportivo on 28 or 29 November. Flick has targeted a top-eight finish in the Champions League league phase. The squad used Fariñas and Gerard Martín in the back line against Villa because of the defensive absences. De Jong has been used at centre-back in recent weeks. The club expects most of the currently injured players to be available after the break, with Espart the longest-term absence.

stories.headline: Barça respond to PSG defeat with clean-sheet win
stories.summary: The 3-0 victory over Aston Villa was Barcelona’s first Champions League win since the 4-2 defeat to Paris Saint-Germain. The side had also lost the Clásico before beating Alavés 6-1 in La Liga. They now have nine points from four matches.
stories.body: Flick had said before the match that nothing had changed about the objective of finishing in the top eight. Villa arrived with nine points from three wins. The open first half required several interventions from Joan García. After the interval, Raphinha’s two goals in 12 minutes settled the contest. Prince William and Prince George were present in the presidential box as long-standing Villa supporters. A minute of silence was held for Jesús de Miguel and the victims of the Urda train crash, and the Champions League anthem was not played. The result leaves Barça level on points with Villa and four points behind leaders PSG, who beat Villarreal 6-0.
